newsitem.title: LATVIA: UNIBANKA, ZEMES SYNERGIES WERE ABSENT-SOURCE.
newsitem.headline: UNIBANKA, ZEMES SYNERGIES WERE ABSENT-SOURCE.

text.p: An international banking source on Tuesday said the merger between Zemes Bank and Unibanka was cancedlled as there was no synergy between the banks.
"It was really just a matter of when the managers looked at the banks the synergies were not there," the international banking source, who declined to be indentified, told Reuters.
The European Bank for Reconstruction and Development (EBRD) is a key shareholder in both Unibanka and Zemes Banka.
The two banks said earlier in a statement that the merger had been cancelled with the full agreement of all the shareholders.
The banks also said that it was apparent after talks that the benefits to be gained by merging the banks were also not as big as at first believed.
The international banking source said that Zemes Bank had not been afraid that the merger would lead to large-scale closures and staff cuts.
"In talks it did not seem that the banks would be treated differently. The idea was to bring together the best of both banks," the source added.
